title: Complete: a dot product
hints: On each turn, `k` is the position of one matching pair: one number from `a` and one from `b`.
The pair at position `k` is `a[k]` and `b[k]`. Multiply them, and add that product to the total.
explain: The loop visits each position once. The reference multiplies the two numbers at that position and adds the product to a total that starts at 0. Multiply matching pairs, then add: that is the whole dot product.
